user.title: Energy Tariff Helper
user.description: Name this meter — it names the device and its sensors.

pricing.title: Supply charge and tax
pricing.description: The daily supply charge is a fixed amount billed per day, regardless of usage. Window rates are entered excluding tax; enable tax per component to report tax-inclusive values. Afterwards, add the tariff windows with the Add import window and Add export window buttons on the integration page.

data_description.gst_percent: Applied only to the components enabled below. Australian GST is 10%.
data_description.gst_import: Rates you enter for import windows are excluding tax.
data_description.gst_export: Feed-in tariffs are often tax-free, so this is off by default.
data_description.gst_supply_charge: The daily supply charge is normally taxed.

init.title: Supply charge and tax
init.description: The daily supply charge is a fixed amount billed per day, regardless of usage. Rates you enter for tariff windows are treated as excluding tax; enable tax per component to add it to the reported values.

data_description.gst_percent: Applied only to the components enabled below. Australian GST is 10%.
data_description.gst_import: Rates you enter for import windows are excluding tax.
data_description.gst_export: Feed-in tariffs are often tax-free, so this is off by default.
data_description.gst_supply_charge: The daily supply charge is normally taxed.

user.title: Add import window
user.description: A daily period when you pay this import rate.

data_description.start: Inclusive — the window takes effect at this instant.
data_description.end: Exclusive — the next window starts here; use the next window's start time (23:00), not one second before it (22:59:59). An end earlier than the start spans midnight. The same as start covers the whole day.

reconfigure.title: Edit import window
reconfigure.description: A daily period when you pay this import rate.

data_description.start: Inclusive — the window takes effect at this instant.
data_description.end: Exclusive — the next window starts here; use the next window's start time (23:00), not one second before it (22:59:59). An end earlier than the start spans midnight. The same as start covers the whole day.

error.overlaps_existing: This overlaps an existing window. Where windows overlap, the one with the later start time takes effect. Submit again to accept.
